name: ferrari-jacket-cinematic-mirror-selfie
image_purpose: male mirror selfie, jacket, bathroom, and cinematic lighting reference

prompt.project_info: Create a hyper-realistic bathroom mirror selfie of an approved adult man in a generic black-and-red racing-inspired jacket.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult man with the supplied hairstyle and identity, wearing a black jacket with generic red panels and abstract patches, black T-shirt, silver rings, and chain.
prompt.composition_elements: Dim modern bathroom with dark marble walls, beige phone case, mirror reflection, same pose and camera angle as the supplied reference, moody cinematic still without brand logos.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft low-key moody bathroom lighting, dark cinematic contrast, subtle filmic color grade.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic smartphone mirror photography, portrait 4:5, accurate reflection, natural skin texture, high detail, restrained grain.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Approved adult man takes a cinematic bathroom mirror selfie wearing a generic black-and-red racing-inspired jacket over a black T-shirt, with silver rings, chain, and beige phone case. Use dark marble walls, soft moody light, accurate reflection, supplied hairstyle and identity, and no brand logos or readable private text.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, sexualized pose, nudity, distorted reflection, extra fingers, fake brand logo, copyrighted racing mark, private text, watermark, public figure likeness.
